_readme: Every place on the page, pinned. coords are [longitude, latitude], verified June 2026 against Google Maps / OSM. The popup's Google Maps link searches by name unless maps_url is set. Add a place by adding an entry; the page needs no other change.

recommendations.name: Khirokitia
recommendations.note: A UNESCO-listed Neolithic settlement, around 9,000 years old, with reconstructed stone round houses on site.

recommendations.name: Cyprus Museum, Nicosia
recommendations.note: The island's main archaeological museum, spanning nine millennia of Cypriot history.

recommendations.name: Kourion
recommendations.note: A Greco-Roman city with a restored theatre set on a cliff above the sea.

recommendations.name: Kato Paphos Archaeological Park
recommendations.note: A UNESCO site known for its Roman mosaic floors, preserved where they were laid.

recommendations.name: Tombs of the Kings
recommendations.note: A UNESCO necropolis of rock-cut underground tombs from the Hellenistic period.

recommendations.name: Petra tou Romiou
recommendations.note: A coastal rock formation traditionally named as the birthplace of Aphrodite.

recommendations.name: Ancient Salamis
recommendations.note: An ancient city-kingdom on the east coast, with a Roman gymnasium and colonnade beside the sea.

recommendations.name: St Hilarion Castle
recommendations.note: A ruined mountain castle in the north with panoramic views over the coast.

recommendations.name: Agios Nikolaos tis Stegis
recommendations.note: A UNESCO Byzantine church with a distinctive steep barn roof, near old Kakopetria.

recommendations.name: Ledra Street crossing
recommendations.note: A pedestrian crossing point between the south and north of divided Nicosia; bring a passport.

recommendations.name: Buyuk Han
recommendations.note: A restored Ottoman caravanserai, now home to craft workshops and cafes.

recommendations.name: Selimiye Mosque
recommendations.note: A Gothic former cathedral in north Nicosia, converted to a mosque with added minarets.

recommendations.name: Home for Cooperation
recommendations.note: A bicommunal cultural centre and cafe inside the UN buffer zone.

recommendations.name: Famagusta walled city
recommendations.note: A Venetian walled city with a Gothic cathedral converted into a mosque.

recommendations.name: Varosha
recommendations.note: A resort quarter sealed off and abandoned since 1974, now partly open to visitors on foot.

recommendations.name: Troodos Geopark Visitor Centre
recommendations.note: A visitor centre explaining the geology and trails of the Troodos mountains.

recommendations.name: Red Lake, Mitsero
recommendations.note: A former mine pit filled with vivid red, mineral-laden water, half an hour from Nicosia.

recommendations.name: Tzelefos Bridge
recommendations.note: A Venetian-era stone 'camel bridge' deep in the Paphos Forest.

recommendations.name: Baths of Aphrodite trailhead
recommendations.note: The starting point for the Adonis and Aphrodite coastal trails in the Akamas.

recommendations.name: Teisia tis Madaris
recommendations.note: A high ridge trail in the Troodos with sweeping views, often above the clouds.

recommendations.name: Avakas Gorge
recommendations.note: A narrow limestone gorge in the Akamas, walkable along the streambed.

recommendations.name: Lara Bay
recommendations.note: A remote, undeveloped Akamas beach and a protected sea-turtle nesting site (June to September).

recommendations.name: The vulture cliffs at Episkopi
recommendations.note: Cliffs above Zapallo Bay home to a colony of griffon vultures.

recommendations.name: Larnaca Salt Lake
recommendations.note: A salt lake that hosts flamingos in winter (November to March) and dries to a white crust in summer.

recommendations.name: Akrotiri marsh
recommendations.note: A wetland on the Akrotiri peninsula, one of the island's best birdwatching sites year-round.

recommendations.name: Zenobia wreck
recommendations.note: A large car-ferry wreck off Larnaca, ranked among the world's best dive sites.

recommendations.name: MUSAN
recommendations.note: An underwater sculpture museum off Ayia Napa, explored by snorkel or dive.

recommendations.name: Cape Greco sea caves
recommendations.note: Sea caves and cliffs at the island's southeast tip, popular for kayaking and swimming.

recommendations.name: Nissi Beach
recommendations.note: A well-known Ayia Napa beach with a sandbar you can wade across to a small islet.

recommendations.name: Fig Tree Bay
recommendations.note: A sandy Protaras bay regularly listed among Europe's best beaches.

recommendations.name: Konnos Bay
recommendations.note: A sheltered, quieter bay between Ayia Napa and Protaras.

recommendations.name: Blue Lagoon, Akamas
recommendations.note: A bright turquoise bay on the Akamas peninsula, reached by boat or 4x4.

recommendations.name: Sofia And Andreas Traditional House
recommendations.note: A family home in Letymvou serving traditional lunches, with halloumi made on site; book ahead.

recommendations.name: Hercules Fish Tavern, Zygi
recommendations.note: A fish tavern in the coastal village of Zygi, known for its calamari.

recommendations.name: To souvlaki tou Soukri, Paralimni
recommendations.note: A Paralimni grill known for its souvlaki.

recommendations.name: Adamos Tavern, Lefkara
recommendations.note: A village tavern in Lefkara popular with locals.

recommendations.name: Katoi, Omodos
recommendations.note: A tavern in Omodos known for clay-oven kleftiko.

recommendations.name: Bemba (Μπέμπα)
recommendations.note: Modern Cypriot cooking in Nicosia's old town.

recommendations.name: Topika Meze Bar
recommendations.note: A meze restaurant on Nicosia's old-town food row.

recommendations.name: Picnic Nicosia
recommendations.note: A brunch spot in Nicosia's old town.

recommendations.name: Rokoko Kitchen & Bar
recommendations.note: A bar and kitchen in Nicosia's old town.

recommendations.name: Granazi (γρανάζι)
recommendations.note: A bar with food in Nicosia.

recommendations.name: OXI Market
recommendations.note: A farmers' market on Nicosia's Venetian walls, Wednesday and Saturday mornings.

recommendations.name: Zambartas Winery
recommendations.note: A respected family winery working with indigenous Cypriot grapes.

recommendations.name: Vlassides Winery
recommendations.note: A winery near Kilani known for its Shiraz.

recommendations.name: Revecca Winery, Agios Mamas
recommendations.note: A small family winery producing Commandaria, the island's traditional dessert wine.

recommendations.name: Casale Panayiotis, Kalopanayiotis
recommendations.note: A restored mountain village turned spa hotel in Kalopanayiotis.

recommendations.name: Apokryfo, Lofou
recommendations.note: A boutique hotel in the restored stone village of Lofou, near the wineries.

recommendations.name: Anassa
recommendations.note: A luxury beach resort near Latchi, known for its service.

recommendations.name: Latchi harbour
recommendations.note: A fishing harbour near the Akamas, lined with fish tavernas on the quay.

recommendations.name: Hamam Omerye
recommendations.note: A working Ottoman bathhouse in Nicosia, in use since 1571.
